## Switzerland and Romania: the forms now show the right currency

In Switzerland and Romania the prices arrive in francs and lei - CHF/kWh
and RON/kWh - but the forms for the **retail formula** and the
**time-of-day grid charges** asked for the amounts in EUR/kWh. Whatever is
typed there is added to the prices as it is, so an amount typed in euro
counted as francs or lei. In Romania that made a surcharge about five times
too small; in Switzerland the difference is a few percent.

The forms now say CHF/kWh and RON/kWh. Nothing else changes: prices, plans
and windows were already in the right currency.

**Using the retail formula or grid charges in Switzerland or Romania?**
Open **Settings > Devices & services > Energy Price Forecast EU >
Reconfigure** and check the surcharge and the grid charge amounts. If you
typed them in euro, convert them into francs or lei and save.

Every other market is unchanged.

**After updating, restart Home Assistant.** Reloading the integration is not
enough.
